title: On partial groups of small order
summary: We explain a computer enumeration of all partial groups (in the sense of Chermak) of order at most 10. An accompanying dataset contains a full list, consisting of 123,650 partial groups of order at most 9 and 178,937,003 partial groups of order 10; the paper itself contains a complete list of indecomposable partial groups of order at most 5.
